name: Enphase IQ8X 0.38 kW per panel

image.alt: Enphase IQ8X microinverter; genuine product image from the maker authored Australian and New Zealand datasheet.

pros: Each panel works independently, helping with mixed roof directions and uneven shade.
Individual panel monitoring can show which panel needs attention.
cons: Each panel needs its own unit, plus shared connection equipment.
Blackout power needs an Enphase battery and extra backup equipment.

cost.variant: One IQ8X-80-M-INT, 380 W rated AC output
cost.basis: Exact microinverter unit price A$245.50, divided by 0.38 kW rated AC power. Retailer terms state AUD prices include applicable GST. Gateway, relays, cabling, installation and delivery are separate; this is not a whole-array package price.

efficiency.basis: European weighted efficiency for the exact IQ8X from the Australian datasheet. Not its peak efficiency or a battery measurement.

warranty.basis: AU hardware workmanship and materials cover for the exact IQ8X SKU is 25 years from activation. Registration and continuous internet connection through an IQ Gateway are required. Separately bought Gateway and relays have their own shorter terms; labour is excluded.

technicalSpecs.label: Selected unit
technicalSpecs.value: IQ8X-80-M-INT, one microinverter for one panel; 230 V, single phase AC connection.

technicalSpecs.label: Output power
technicalSpecs.value: 380 W rated continuous AC output; 384 W maximum AC output.

technicalSpecs.label: Panel pairing
technicalSpecs.value: Designed for higher-voltage panel types, including typical 80 or 88 half-cell and 96-cell panels; voltage and current limits must match.

technicalSpecs.label: European weighted efficiency
technicalSpecs.value: 96.7% for the exact IQ8X unit.

technicalSpecs.label: Size and weight
technicalSpecs.value: 212 mm high, 175 mm wide, 30.2 mm deep, excluding bracket; 1.1 kg.

technicalSpecs.label: Protection and temperature
technicalSpecs.value: IP67; ambient operating range -40°C to 65°C.

technicalSpecs.label: Shared equipment
technicalSpecs.value: Requires the compatible IQ Gateway and system connection equipment, bought separately. One unit alone is not a complete solar system.

technicalSpecs.label: Blackout coverage
technicalSpecs.value: An AU backup installation also needs a compatible Enphase battery and IQ System Controller. The microinverter alone does not provide household backup.

technicalSpecs.label: Parts warranty
technicalSpecs.value: IQ8X unit 25 years with registration and an internet-connected Gateway; external Gateway and IQ Relay 5 years. Removal and installation labour excluded.

technicalSpecs.label: Price scope
technicalSpecs.value: Retailer unit price includes applicable GST under its terms of sale. Shared equipment, delivery and installation are additional.

freshness.note: Enphase announced the IQ8X Australian launch on 3 October 2024. This exact IQ8X unit is distinct from the earlier Australian IQ8AC and IQ8HC models.

name: SMA Sunny Boy Smart Energy 5 kW

image.alt: Product range shown: current SMA Sunny Boy Smart Energy cabinet used by the Australian SBSE5.0-50.

pros: Can start with solar panels and add a compatible battery later.
Handles three roof directions with one quiet, fanless unit.
cons: Standard outage power is one manually switched outlet, not automatic whole-home backup.
The standard fault warranty is shorter than its advertised registered warranty.

warranty.basis: Five year included manufacturer hardware warranty for the inverter. An extra five years needs registration within 30 days and is not included in the numeric term. Paid extensions are also excluded.

technicalSpecs.label: Selected unit
technicalSpecs.value: Australian SBSE5.0-50, 5 kW rated AC output. Single phase 230 V.

technicalSpecs.label: Solar capacity
technicalSpecs.value: Up to 10 kW maximum solar array power; three separately tracked roof groups.

technicalSpecs.label: Battery connection
technicalSpecs.value: Supports approved high-voltage batteries. Battery is separate and the exact battery compatibility list applies.

technicalSpecs.label: Standard outage power
technicalSpecs.value: Secure Power Supply can feed a dedicated outlet up to 3.68 kW after manual activation. Solar or stored battery energy must be available.

technicalSpecs.label: Whole-home backup
technicalSpecs.value: Optional backup arrangements need extra equipment. This selected inverter alone does not provide automatic whole-home backup.

technicalSpecs.label: Size and weight
technicalSpecs.value: 500 mm wide, 586 mm high, 236 mm deep; 17.5 kg.

technicalSpecs.label: Noise and protection
technicalSpecs.value: Fanless natural convection cooling; maximum stated noise 35 dB(A), IP65 protection.

technicalSpecs.label: Parts warranty
technicalSpecs.value: Five years standard. Free extension to 10 years requires registration within 30 days; extensions are not used by the bar.

technicalSpecs.label: Efficiency scope
technicalSpecs.value: The AU sheet lists peak efficiency but no comparable European weighted figure. Efficiency is therefore not scored.
